mapper.update: UPDATE T_RAG_DOC SET STATUS = COALESCE(#{status}, STATUS) ,PAGE_COUNT = COALESCE(#{pageCount}, PAGE_COUNT) ,CHUNK_COUNT = COALESCE(#{chunkCount}, CHUNK_COUNT) ,MESSAGE = #{message} ,UPD_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND ID = #{docId}
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS DOC_ID ,TITLE ,SOURCE ,FILE_NAME ,STATUS ,PAGE_COUNT ,CHUNK_COUNT ,MESSAGE ,INS_DAY ,UPD_DAY FROM T_RAG_DOC ORDER BY ID DESC

SELECT C.ID AS CHUNK_ID ,C.DOC_ID ,C.SEQ ,C.PAGE ,C.CONTENT ,D.TITLE ,D.SOURCE ,1 - (C.EMBEDDING <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector)) AS SCORE FROM T_RAG_CHUNK C JOIN T_RAG_DOC D ON D.ID = C.DOC_ID AND D.STATUS = 'READY' ORDER BY C.EMBEDDING <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector) LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE T_RAG_DOC SET STATUS = 'FAIL' ,MESSAGE = '서버가 다시 시작되면서 처리가 중단됐어요. 다시 올려주세요.' ,UPD_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS = 'PROCESSING'
